text:
leah: Quick triage — Support surfaced two customer asks this week that look like integration work and might be backlog candidates for next sprint. 1) Terraform provider to provision dedicated pools with network + KMS support. 2) Marketplace listing requirements + SCIM/SSO wiring for ISV onboarding (docs + sample SDK snippets). Can we scope these and decide prioritization? cc @michael @anya
support_jordan: Customer: AcmeRetail, ticket #4582. They want to fully automate infra for dev/stage/prod using Terraform. Currently doing manual steps. Also asking about marketplace listing so they can distribute internally to teams. I can share their runbook.
michael: Quick clarifying q — are they asking for a full HashiCorp provider or a set of opinionated modules that wrap our API? Any custom resources needed beyond pool/network/KMS?
leah: From the intake call: they want a provider experience (single provider) ideally, not just modules. Main resources: redwood_dedicated_pool, redwood_network_binding, redwood_kms_key. Priority: medium but revenue opportunity if we enable marketplace channel.
anya: For marketplace we usually require: docs, sample Terraform examples, install/upgrade doc, a quickstart in Python and JS SDK, and an SSO/SCIM connector spec. I can draft a checklist. Suggest we tag this as `marketplace-integration` + `ppc:customer-driven`.
triage-bot: Auto-tag suggestion based on content: `integration/terraform`, `integration/scim`, priority `P2`. Recommend add to backlog with label `needs-scoping`.
julian: Rough engineering estimate (MVP): provider core + unit tests ~ 3w eng effort, docs ~1w, security review ~1w. SCIM/SSO connector MVP ~2w eng + 1w infra/config. Need to validate infra dependencies (KMS APIs, RBAC). Acceptance criteria incoming.
leah: Proposed acceptance criteria to validate scope: - Provider v0: CRUD for redwood_dedicated_pool, network binding, and KMS key; terraform registry publish guide; CI e2e that provisions/destroys a test env. - Marketplace: listing draft + install steps, SSO/SCIM config page, Python and JS quickstart snippets. If those are reasonable I'll split into two workstreams and propose for sprint planning.
michael: Also requires an e2e harness for terraform flows (CI job + ephemeral infra). I'll draft an RFC for provider API endpoints and expected lifecycle behavior.
leah: Action items: @anya create checklist PR in `docs/platform-integrations` (use our marketplace template). @michael write RFC + rough timeline. @triage-bot please create backlog card with tags: `integration/terraform`, `marketplace`, `customer:AcmeRetail`, `status:triage` and assign to eng-platform. I'll bring to sprint planning and propose priority split.
support_jordan: +1, adding ticket #4582 and AcmeRetail contact details to the backlog card. :thumbsup:
